Package org.opencv.dnn

Class LayerInfo

java.lang.Object
org.opencv.dnn.LayerInfo
Direct Known Subclasses:
Layer
public class LayerInfo extends Object
Backend-independent description of a graph operation (node). %LayerInfo carries everything needed to reason about an operation *without* executing it: its parameters (#blobs and type-specific fields of derived classes), graph wiring (#inputs / #outputs as Arg indices) and shape/type/layout inference. The new DNN graph engine stores a topologically sorted sequence of %LayerInfo nodes (see Graph::prog()); executable, backend-specific instances (Layer subclasses) are constructed from an %LayerInfo during Net::finalizeNet(). Each operation type registers a static Ptr&lt;LayerInfo&gt; create(const LayerParams&amp;) factory via REF: CV_DNN_REGISTER_OP_CLASS.
